A készítés folyamata

Hogyan készül az egyedi bőrkabát?

Ha a kollekcióban nem találja meg a pontos fazon-, bőr-, szín- vagy méretkombinációt, méretre szabott szolgáltatásunkkal megvalósítjuk elképzelését.

01 · MODELL & FAZON

Tervezés és elképzelés

Hozzon egy mintafotót, rajzot, vagy válasszon üzletünk fazonjai közül. Átbeszéljük a szabásvonalat, gallért, zsebeket és a kívánt stílust (motoros dzseki, cafe racer, elegáns zakó vagy hosszú kabát).

02 · BŐR & KELLÉKEK

Anyag- és színválasztás

Válassza ki a megfelelő bőrtípust: selymesen puha báránybőr nappa a könnyed eleganciáért, strapabíró marhabőr a masszív tartásért, vagy velúr. Kiválasztjuk a bélésanyagot és a fém kellékeket (antik réz, ezüst vagy matt fekete).

03 · PONTOS MÉRETEK

Mesteri méretvétel

A vállszélesség, ujjhossz, mellbőség és derékvonal pontos méreteit személyesen vesszük le üzletünkben, biztosítva, hogy a kabát kényelmesen feküdjön a megszokott ruharétegeken.

04 · MŰHELYMUNKA

Elkészítés és próba

Több mint öt évtizedes bőrműves tapasztalattal szabjuk és varrjuk a kabátot. Elkészülte után személyes próbán ellenőrizzük a kényelmet és az illeszkedést.

Szakszerű gondoskodás

Bőrjavítás és felújítás

Egy valódi bőrkabát évtizedekig hű társa maradhat. Segítséget nyújtunk a bőr felsőruházat javításában és karbantartásában, megőrizve annak épségét és szépségét.

  • Fém kellékek és cipzárak: Főcipzárak, ujjcipzárak, patentok és csatok szakszerű cseréje.
  • Méretigazítás és átalakítás: Ujjhossz rövidítés, derékszűkítés és varrások igazítása.
  • Béléscsere: Elhasználódott bélések cseréje minőségi selyem-, szatén- vagy pamutanyagra.
  • Bőrápolás és kondicionálás: Kiszáradt, megkopott bőrök mélytáplálása speciális bőrápoló szerekkel.

The Tailoring Process

How a custom leather jacket is created

When you cannot find the exact cut, hide, colour or size in the collection, our bespoke tailoring process brings your vision to life.

01 · INSPIRATION & CUT

Design & Silhouette

Bring a reference photo, sketch, or choose from our boutique styles. We discuss silhouette, collar structure, pockets, and cut (classic biker, cafe racer, tailored blazer or long coat).

02 · HIDE & HARDWARE

Material Selection

Choose your preferred leather: buttery soft lambskin nappa for lightweight luxury, sturdy cowhide for rugged durability, or rich suede. Select lining fabrics and metal hardware finishes (antique brass, silver, or matte black).

03 · PRECISION SIZING

Master Measurements

Accurate shoulder width, sleeve length, chest circumference and torso posture measurements are taken in store to ensure your jacket drapes impeccably over your natural layers.

04 · ARTISAN CRAFTING

Fitting & Completion

Crafted with five decades of leather-working expertise. After crafting, a final fitting in our Budapest boutique confirms comfort, movement and proportions before you take your piece home.

Expert Services

Leather Repairs & Restoration

A genuine leather jacket is an enduring companion. We assist with repairs and restorative maintenance for leather outerwear to preserve their beauty and longevity.

  • Hardware & Zippers: Replacement of broken front zippers, cuff zippers, snaps and buckles.
  • Alterations & Resizing: Sleeve shortening, waist adjustment, and seam refinement.
  • Lining Replacement: Restoring worn or damaged internal linings with premium fabrics.
  • Leather Conditioning: Deep moisturizing and conditioning treatments for dry or weathered hides.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Key questions about our store, custom orders and payment.

Do you offer made-to-measure leather jackets?

Yes. Custom leather jacket orders are available; style, colour, sizing, material and production details are discussed in person.

Where is the Kaftan Angelo store?

1053 Budapest, Kossuth Lajos utca 18, between Astoria and Ferenciek tere.

What payment methods do you accept?

Cash and credit card payments are available in store; HUF and EUR are accepted.

Can I try the jackets on before buying?

Yes. The website shows a selection; garments can be tried on in person at our Budapest store.

Do you offer repairs?

We can assist with arranging repairs for leather items purchased from our store. Options depend on the condition of the item and the type of repair required.

What products do you carry?

Genuine leather jackets and coats for women and men, shearling and fur styles, plus leather accessories.

How can I ask about a specific model?

Message us on WhatsApp at +36 20 359 3216 or call the store at +36 1 266 7274.

What are the opening hours?

Monday to Friday 10:00–19:00, Saturday 10:00–17:00. Closed Sunday.

Visiting and online enquiries

Can I buy through the website?

The website presents the selection; it has no online cart or payment. Agree availability and purchasing details with the store.

Does the gallery show current stock?

The photos show a selection rather than real-time stock. Enquire before visiting if a specific model, colour or size matters.

What should I bring to a fitting?

Bring your usual layer and a photo of the chosen model. Ask about material, lining, care and any proposed adjustment for that particular garment.

Our Story

From Istanbul to the heart of Budapest

Kaftan Angelo is a leather and fur clothing store in central Budapest, between Astoria and Ferenciek tere.

1973 · ISTANBUL

The story began with the craft of leather.

Angelo began working with leather in Istanbul in 1973.

2004 · BUDAPEST

The experience found a new home.

In 2004, Angelo brought decades of experience to Budapest and opened his city-centre store.

TODAY · KOSSUTH LAJOS U. 18

Finding the right piece remains personal.

We offer genuine leather jackets and coats for women and men, shearling and fur styles, and leather accessories. If the right piece is not in the collection, a leather jacket can also be made to order.

A personal choice

More than choosing a photograph

A jacket becomes part of everyday life. Material, proportion and comfortable movement should work together, rather than one detail deciding the whole choice.

Start with how you will wear it

Think about your usual layers and the shapes you enjoy. Compare leather, shearling and fur for the actual garment, not just the category name.

Compare the materials →

See the fit in person

Try the piece open and fastened, sit and reach forward. The online collection introduces the styles; an in-store fitting lets you judge the feel and proportions yourself.

Fitting checklist →

Ask before deciding

Discuss the material, care and current availability. For a custom leather jacket, style, colour, measurements and timing are agreed individually.

Custom-order enquiries →

Our Budapest store opened in 2004. Today the collection brings together women’s and men’s leather jackets, shearling coats, fur styles and leather accessories at Kossuth Lajos u. 18, Budapest 1053.

Analitika és munkamenet-felvételek

A Google Tag Manager csak akkor töltődik be, ha Ön legalább egy mérési célt engedélyez. A Google Analytics 4 látogatási statisztikái és a Microsoft Clarity munkamenet-felvételei külön választhatók. A Google Analytics oldalmegtekintéseket, forrásokat, hozzávetőleges országadatokat, görgetést, valamint telefon-, útvonal- és WhatsApp-kattintásokat mér. Ezek érdeklődési jelek, nem igazolt üzletlátogatások vagy vásárlások. A Microsoft Clarity engedély esetén kattintási és görgetési térképeket és szigorúan maszkolt munkamenet-felvételeket készít. Cookies and External Services

Technical storage, maps and external connections used by this website.

Updated: 2026-10-09

Analytics and session recordings

Google Tag Manager loads only if you allow at least one measurement purpose. Google Analytics 4 visit statistics and Microsoft Clarity session recordings can be selected separately. Both are off by default. Rejecting optional tracking prevents these tracking codes from loading; we do not request advertising consent.

Google Analytics measures page views, traffic sources, approximate country information, scrolling, and phone, directions and WhatsApp clicks. These are interest signals, not confirmed store visits or purchases. When permitted, Microsoft Clarity creates click and scroll maps and strictly masked session recordings. We do not load measurement code on the partner portal or send form entries or PINs in measurement events.

We store your choice in the kaftan_consent_v1 browser-storage entry for 180 days. Withdraw it at any time using Cookie settings in the footer. Withdrawal deletes accessible Analytics and Clarity cookies on this site and reloads the page; it does not recall data already sent. We configure Google Analytics cookies to last at most 60 days.

Providers: Google Ireland Limited and Microsoft. The providers may process data outside the EEA under their own privacy arrangements. See Google Privacy Policy and Microsoft Privacy Statement. Controller and contact: Alfina Fashion Kft., Kossuth Lajos u. 18, Budapest 1053; alfinafashionkft@gmail.com.

GA4 user- and event-level retention is two months, with reset on new activity disabled. Aggregated standard reports may follow different retention rules.

Legal basis and your rights

Optional measurement is based on your consent. Rejecting it does not restrict use of the website. You may request access, correction, erasure or restriction from the controller, and exercise data portability where its conditions apply. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing. You may complain to the Hungarian supervisory authority, NAIH.

Clarity recordings and aggregated data have different retention periods; selected samples and favourites may be kept longer. See Microsoft’s retention description. Deleting browser cookies is different from deleting data already held by a provider.

Maps only on request

Google Maps on the store page loads only through the “Show map” button. Your browser then connects to Google and technical data such as an IP address or browser information may be transmitted. Close it using the same button in the map area. This does not recall data already transmitted. The choice applies to the current page only; it is not saved in cookies or browser storage.

Google Privacy Policy

Browser storage and search

The daily information text uses no browser storage. After a successful partner login, the portal stores its displayed account view in that tab’s sessionStorage for up to 30 minutes to preserve it across refreshes; it does not save the PIN there. Logout clears the view. Content search uses a local Pagefind index.

External links and hosting

WhatsApp, Instagram, email and journey planner links open external services or applications when you click. Those services’ own privacy policies apply to subsequent use. GitHub Pages serves this website; technical requests and provider logs may be involved in hosting. This page does not claim that external providers process no data.

GitHub Privacy Statement

Questions and settings
